description: This file defines the PackageManager class responsible for handling package operations such as downloading, installing, uninstalling, and managing package metadata in the SuiteCRM platform. It interacts with external services for package information and provides utilities for package validation and processing.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Handles package management tasks including download, installation, uninstallation, and communication with external package repositories.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PackageManager, setting up database and upload directory.

methods.name: initializeComm
methods.description: Placeholder for initializing communication with external services.

methods.name: getPromotion
methods.description: Retrieves a promotional message from the depot.

methods.name: getModuleLoaderCategoryPackages
methods.description: Fetches category packages used in module loader.

methods.name: getCategoryPackages
methods.description: Retrieves categories and associated packages from the depot.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Gets categories from the depot based on parent category.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Fetches packages within a category.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Retrieves releases for a given package.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a specific release file from the depot.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials with the depot.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Stores user credentials in the system settings.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves stored user credentials.

methods.name: getTermsAndConditions
methods.description: Fetches the terms and conditions from the depot.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for available package updates.

methods.name: toNameValueList
methods.description: Converts an associative array to a name-value list.

methods.name: toNameValueLists
methods.description: Converts multiple arrays to name-value lists.

methods.name: fromNameValueList
methods.description: Converts a name-value list back to an associative array.

methods.name: buildInstalledReleases
methods.description: Builds a list of installed releases suitable for update checks.

methods.name: buildPackageXML
methods.description: Creates an XML representation of a package and its releases.

methods.name: extractFile
methods.description: Extracts a specified file from a zip archive to a temporary directory.

methods.name: extractManifest
methods.description: Extracts the manifest.php file from a package zip.

methods.name: validateManifestType
methods.description: Validates the package's manifest type.

methods.name: validateManifestVersion
methods.description: Validates the manifest's version compatibility.

methods.name: validate_manifest
methods.description: Performs overall validation of the package manifest.

methods.name: getInstallType
methods.description: Determines the installation type based on the directory structure.

methods.name: performSetup
methods.description: Handles the setup process for a package zip file, including manifest validation and file copying.

methods.name: unlinkTempFiles
methods.description: Deletes temporary uploaded files.

methods.name: performInstall
methods.description: Performs installation of a zip package, including manifest processing and upgrade history recording.

methods.name: performUninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package based on upgrade history.

methods.name: getUITextForType
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for a package type.

methods.name: getImageForType
methods.description: Returns an icon image associated with a package type.

methods.name: getPackagesInStaging
methods.description: Lists packages available in staging for upload or staging environment.

methods.name: getLicenseFromFile
methods.description: Reads license text from a package file.

methods.name: getInstalled
methods.description: Fetches installed upgrade records of specified types.

methods.name: getinstalledPackages
methods.description: Provides a list of installed packages with details, including metadata from manifests.
